title: Root processes DIOs instead of rejecting them
description:
## Location
rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs line 323 (`process_dio` entry)

## Issue
`process_dio()` has no early return for `DodagRole::Root`. A root node should never accept DIOs since it IS the DODAG authority. Currently, roots only happen to reject same-version DIOs due to the rank equality check at line 370, which is accidental protection.

## Why this matters
- Root state can be corrupted by crafted DIOs
- Opens door to version-bump attack (see related P0)
- Future code changes might remove the accidental protection

## Existing test misleading
Test `root_ignores_dio` (line 802) passes because same-version DIOs are rejected by rank check, not by role check. Test does not cover newer-version DIOs.

## Suggested fix
Add at function entry (after ETX validation):
```rust
// SECURITY: Root nodes are DODAG authorities; they do not accept DIOs.
if self.role == DodagRole::Root {
    return DioOutcome::Rejected;
}
```
close_reason: Fixed: Root now explicitly rejects all DIOs via early return on role check, added test for newer-version DIOs
